title: A fresh executor can implement and prove a planned slice without hidden context

task.prompt: Plan one independently deployable vertical slice, then give only its issue file and repo snapshot to a fresh executor using the same model and budget.
task.fixture: isolated typed web-service repo with one public API seam and existing tests

requirements.criterion: The cold executor completes every AC through the issue's named public seam and produces replayable command, exit/tally, and artifact evidence.
The final diff contains no behavior outside the issue and its declared dependency/write set.

graders.procedure: Run the issue's exact verification commands and full fixture suite; require exit 0, expected tally, and evidence for every AC.
Compare the final diff with the issue AC/touches/test_paths and fail on an unowned behavior or file.
